answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 56 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. The reef register is checked at draw time, spiral lists the eligible set, and raven seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 56 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time anyone pays for every seat it wants. A 191 account operation therefore ties up 28 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
